messages:
Priya: Heads-up — we need to lock dependencies for the Q2 'elastic-cache' pilot. Can product/eng/runtime/infra/security align on launch criteria, prewarm window, and fallback behavior? cc @Ethan @Maya @Leo @Sam
Ethan: Quick context: product wants ~250ms p95 for sustained 2k rps with burst to 5k for ~15m. We'll need dedicated prewarm slots + KV cache warming. Is that the ask?
Maya: Yes. Runtime needs a 10min prewarm + prefix/KV caching for the top ~100 prefixes. Also requesting an explicit fallback path to a smaller quantized model when capacity is constrained.
Leo: Infra note: we can reserve burst capacity but reservations need 48h lead time. If KMS/HSM is required for keys we need an onboarding ticket and key rotation window. What SLA are we targeting?
Priya: Target SLA is 99.9% for launch. This is customer-data-sensitive so KMS onboarding is required — I'll open the ticket today.
Sam: Security ok with KMS + audit logs. Need a short threat-model review and an IaC policy for key access. Confirming telemetry contains no PII (expected no).
Ethan: Important for rollout: can runtime support tenant-scoped canaries so we can stagger traffic? Implementation would be a route flag + rollout policy.
Maya: We have canary routing. Suggested config example for the rollout:```json
{"route":"canary","percent":5,"fallback_model":"m-small-q4"}
```This will let us test warmup and fallback paths without full cutover.
Leo: I'll queue 2x burst nodes and set autoscale window to 20m. Reservation ETA: tomorrow morning — I'll post the reservation ID when done.
Priya: Action items: Priya -> open KMS ticket (#TICKET-4321); Ethan -> add canary flag + fallback implementation by Tue; Maya -> add prefix warm list + evals; Leo -> reserve burst nodes; Sam -> schedule threat-model review. Any objections?
Ethan: :thumbsup: one ask — we should document expected quality delta for the fallback model (latency vs. ROUGE/BLEU or other metric), so product knows tradeoffs.
Maya: Will add an eval curve to the spec and attach the prompt set. Metrics to track: generation latency, top-k semantic match, and token cost delta.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: canary-flag-feature toggled in staging at 2024-05-07T02:00Z
Priya: Thanks — I'm going to move this to the checklist. If no objections by EOD, we lock scope and start the tickets.
